heading: Policy on hazing

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Subject to the approval of the Commandant, the Superintendent of the Academy shall issue and make available to the public written policies—

children.text: prescribing dismissal, suspension, or other adequate punishment for violations.

tree.heading: Effect of Request for Court-martial.—
tree.text: If a cadet who is charged with violating a policy issued under subsection (a), the penalty for which is or may be dismissal from the Academy, requests in writing a trial by a general court-martial, the cadet may not be dismissed for that offense except under sentence of such a court.

tree.heading: Limitation.—
tree.text: A cadet dismissed from the Academy for hazing or bullying may not be reappointed to the Corps of Cadets, and is ineligible for appointment as commissioned 1 officer in a regular component of the Coast Guard, until the date that is 2 years after the date of the graduation of the class of the cadet.

tree.heading: Definition of Hazing.—
tree.text: In developing the policies under subsection (a)(1), the Superintendent shall, to the maximum extent practicable, define the term “hazing” as the unauthorized assumption of authority by a cadet whereby another cadet suffers or is exposed to any cruelty, indignity, humiliation, hardship, or oppression, or the deprivation or abridgement of any right.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 119–60, div. G, title LXXII, § 7245(a), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1730.)
